title: Design: New Tier name errors show in red under the field
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, archived, named for example Fleet Old.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click New Tier.
  3. Click Create Tier.
  4. Type tier A's name.
  5. Click Create Tier.
  6. Replace the name with Manual.
  7. Click Create Tier.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • The New Tier page opens.

Step 3:

  • The field is outlined in red and red text under it reads "Tier name is a required field", as in picture 2.12.

Step 4:

  • The name shows in the field.

Step 5:

  • Red text under the outlined field reads "An archived tier is called" tier A's name ". Rename it first.", as in picture 2.14.

Step 6:

  • Manual shows in the field.

Step 7:

  • Red text reads "Manual is used by the reports. Choose another name.", as in picture 2.15.
